I have very sensitive skin and have had irritation issues with numerous BHA products but gave this a shot because of the reviews. This is one of the most gentle BHA serums I have ever used which is suprising considering its 2% BHA. That said, I think 2% bha is too high of a concentration to regularly use on your entire face for most people. I would suggest just using this as a spot treatment. It has a light but emolient texture because of the colloidal oatmeal and layers great under a night cream. I apply it every night just to any visible blemished and they usually are gone by the third day. This is also a great value, I am going on the 3rd month using this as a spot treatment and think this will last 3 more.
